name: Auto Changelog Check
description: Checks if CHANGELOG.md was updated before allowing a git commit
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Check if CHANGELOG.md was updated before git commit
CMD="$1"
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then
  if ! git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q 'CHANGELOG.md'; then
    echo "WARNING: CHANGELOG.md not included in this commit. Consider updating it."
  fi
fi
exit 0
